note: Dated peace treaties between realms of data/realms.json. While a peace holds, letters of marque between the two realms are suspended (mechanic 3). Further peaces are drawn from the game seed (src/game/peace.mjs). A row needs a cited source.

treaties.note: Alcáçovas, signed 4 Sep 1479, ended the War of the Castilian Succession. Open-ended in the data; Tordesillas 1494 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Treaty_of_Tordesillas) split the oceans between the same parties.
The Catholic Monarchs signed for Castile and Aragon.
